title: Deep-Learning-Based Pixelated Microwave Filter Design and Characterization using Electro-Optical Electric-Field Measurements
abstract: arXiv:2606.18402v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Traditional microwave filter design typically relies on iterative parameter tuning and predefined topologies, which limits design space and increases development time. This study uses a deep learning approach combining convolutional neural networks with genetic algorithms to automate pixelated microwave filter synthesis. To validate the approach experimentally, both S-parameter and spatial electric-field measurements were analyzed. The synthesized low-pass filter demonstrated excellent agreement between simulated and measured performance, achieving a 7 GHz passband with over 20 dB suppression beyond 9.5 GHz. Electro-optical measurements, for the first time, revealed electric field patterns that resemble coupled transmission-lines or stub structures, providing insight into the emergent characteristics of AI-generated designs.

translated_title: 基于深度学习的像素化微波滤波器设计及其电光电场测量表征
translated_abstract: 传统的微波滤波器设计通常依赖于迭代参数调整和预定义拓扑结构，这限制了设计空间并增加了开发时间。本研究采用一种结合卷积神经网络与遗传算法的深度学习方法，实现像素化微波滤波器合成的自动化。为实验验证该方法，对S参数和空间电场测量数据进行了分析。合成的低通滤波器在仿真与实测性能之间表现出极好的一致性，实现了7 GHz通带，并在9.5 GHz以上提供超过20 dB的抑制。电光测量首次揭示了类似于耦合传输线或短截线结构的电场分布模式，为人工智能生成设计的涌现特性提供了洞察。
tldr: 本研究首次利用卷积神经网络与遗传算法自动合成像素化微波滤波器，并通过电光电场测量揭示其涌现的耦合传输线或短截线结构，实现了7 GHz通带和9.5 GHz以上20 dB抑制的优异性能。
en_tdlr: This study first combines CNNs with genetic algorithms to automate pixelated microwave filter synthesis and, via electro-optical electric-field measurements, reveals emergent coupled-line or stub-like patterns, achieving a 7 GHz passband with over 20 dB suppression beyond 9.5 GHz.
